name: chat-short
description: W1: a 20-turn standard chat; every turn looks a record up with a native tool call, then answers in text.

turns.user: Turn {turn}: here is the next part of the brief. Please check the record for item {turn} and tell me what changed since the last update, in two short paragraphs.

replies.text:
Turn {turn} summary. The record for item {turn} shows the same owner and a revised estimate; the main change since the last update is the status moving from review to active. Nothing else in the brief contradicts it.

Next, I would confirm the revised estimate with the owner and note the dependency on the previous item before closing this step. Let me know if you want the full record quoted.
